premarket.market_expectations: Markets anticipate a positive opening with moderate bullish sentiment. Overnight gains in US indices and declining dollar strength support risk assets, though mixed domestic institutional flows and stable crude prices may limit upside. The VIX remains subdued while bond yields retreat slightly, creating favorable conditions for equities. Focus stays on large-cap earnings momentum and new listings amid normal trading conviction.
